$comment: Single source of truth for the visual language shared by every app. Each app mirrors these values in its own theme module; keep them in sync.

roles.primary: aqua         - main brand color: folder icons, selection, focus rings, primary buttons
roles.selectionBackground: aquaSubtle   - background of the selected row
roles.hover: purpleMuted  - background of hovered rows / buttons
roles.accentInteractive: purple       - symlinks, active place in the sidebar, breadcrumb separators
roles.accentHighlight: gold         - app title, column headers, current breadcrumb segment, status bar figures

glyphs.$comment: Nerd Font codepoints (Font Awesome range) used for icons.

elevation.$comment: Higher sections are lighter (dark-theme tonal elevation) AND cast a shadow onto lower ones. Shadows are black with the given alpha; offset/blur in px. Order, low to high: file list < column header < toolbar < places sidebar. Tool buttons sit on the toolbar with their own small shadow.

glyphCentering.$comment: Nerd Font icons are drawn wider than their advance width, so their ink sits to the right of the advance centre. Shift a glyph LEFT by this many em to centre it optically inside a button (from the font's glyf/hmtx tables).
